text: Welcome to HealthYarn. Tap English to ask a health question or browse topics.
Ẹ káàbọ̀ sí HealthYarn. Tẹ Yorùbá láti béèrè ìbéèrè ìlera tàbí wo àwọn àkòrí.
Nnọọ na HealthYarn. Pịa Igbo ka ị jụọ ajụjụ ahụike ma ọ bụ lelee isiokwu.
Your voice is used only to understand your question and is not saved.
Ohùn rẹ wà fún lílóye ìbéèrè rẹ nìkan, a kò sì fi pamọ́.
A na-eji olu gị naanị ịghọta ajụjụ gị, anaghị echekwa ya.
This may be an urgent medical danger sign. Please go immediately to the nearest health centre or call an emergency clinic below.
Èyí lè jẹ́ àmì ewu ìlera tó lágbára. Jọ̀wọ́ lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn tó súnmọ́ ọ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ tàbí pe àwọn ilé ìwòsàn ìsàlẹ̀ yìí.
Nke a nwere ike ịbụ mgbaàmà ihe egwu ahụike ngwa ngwa. Biko gaa ụlọọgwụ kacha nso ozugbo ma ọ bụ kpọọ ụlọọgwụ dị n'okpuru.
This guidance provides general health information only and does not replace seeing a doctor or health worker.
Ìmọ̀ràn yìí jẹ́ àlàyé ìlera gbogbogbò nìkan, kò rọ́pò rírí dókítà tàbí òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera.
Ndụmọdụ a bụ naanị ozi ahụike izugbe ma ọ naghị anọchi ịhụ dọkịta ma ọ bụ onye ọrụ ahụike.
I am not completely sure what you asked. Did you mean one of these three questions?
N kò dá mi lójú pátápátá ohun tí o béèrè. Ṣé ọ̀kan nínú àwọn ìbéèrè mẹ́ta yìí ni o túmọ̀ sí?
Amaghị m nke ọma ihe ị jụrụ. Ị pụtara otu n'ime ajụjụ atọ ndị a?
I could not hear your voice clearly right now. Please try again or tap one of the health topics below.
N kò lè gbọ́ ohùn rẹ dáadáa lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́. Jọ̀wọ́ gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i tàbí tẹ ọ̀kan nínú àwọn àkòrí ìsàlẹ̀.
Enweghị m ike ịnụ olu gị nke ọma ugbu a. Biko nwaa ọzọ ma ọ bụ pịa otu n'ime isiokwu dị n'okpuru.
